name: ritim
author: Ediz Ege Mercan
description: Senkron masaustu ve mobil muzik deneyimi

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,SYNC,SOCIAL -c magenta,cyan,yellow "vite --host 0.0.0.0" "tsx watch server/index.ts" "tsx watch server/social.ts"
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n WEB,SYNC,SOCIAL,DESKTOP -c magenta,cyan,yellow,green "vite --host 0.0.0.0" "tsx watch server/index.ts" "tsx watch server/social.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:8787/health http://localhost:8790/health && electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
